universe_rule: Candidates are USDT-M perps with archive history from 2020-01 (verified HTTP 200 on data.binance.vision). Every candidate must have full klines+funding coverage for every calendar month 2020-01..2026-10; any month missing/blocked/partial excludes the symbol with a recorded reason. 5m klines are truncated to the exact window and resampled to 1h OHLCV on the exact 1h UTC grid; funding calc_time is floored to its native Binance funding boundary (8h for most perps, 4h for some; recorded per symbol) and placed on the 1h grid at boundary hours only. The spot leg is real spot 1h klines from data-api.binance.vision/api/v3/klines over the same window; spot feed gaps are NOT imputed: they are recorded per symbol and the runner's fail-closed gates block any trade requiring missing spot data. No impute/ffill/resample of derived series.
